Hi all — quick technical confirmation from the infra/serving side:

- Scope: The opt-out is account-level and, when applied, prevents data from that account from being included in any model training or improvement pipelines. That includes training loops, offline augmentation, and supervised labeling workflows.
- Telemetry & Embeddings: By default we do not use request/response logs or embeddings from opt-out accounts for model improvement. Embeddings created for the customer remain accessible to the customer for retrieval; we do not ingest them into training corpora.
- Logs & Backups: Operational logs (e.g., runtime logs, audit trails) are retained for our operational needs and security auditing. We can offer restricted retention windows or deletion workflows on a case-by-case basis; this typically requires a formal request and coordination with our infra team.
- Data residency: For hosted accounts, data is stored in the region associated with the account. For Acme (US), we keep data in US regions only by default unless otherwise configured. We can provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and SOC 2 artifacts under NDA.

Process: Marissa — attach the opt-out form. Once signed and returned to legal@redwood.example.com and ops@redwood.example.com, ops will enact the opt-out and reply with a confirmation ticket. Target SLA: 24–48 business hours after receipt of signed form.

-Rishi

Alicia — thanks, and appreciate the clear asks. Confirmations below and next steps: 

1) Scope confirmations (explicit):
- Embeddings & derived vectors: included in the opt-out. We will not ingest embeddings or derived vectors from opt-out accounts into any model training or model improvement pipelines.
- Aggregated telemetry: we will not use opt-out accounts' telemetry in aggregated datasets that could alter model behavior. Operational metrics (error rates, infra metrics) will continue to be measured but are not used to train models.
- Contract survivability: the opt-out is applied at the account level and will remain in effect across renewals unless Acme provides an explicit opt-in instruction. We’ll also record the opt-out in your account metadata and legal files.

2) Paperwork & timeline:
- I have initiated a DocuSign envelope for the attached training_opt_out_form.pdf and CC'd procurement as requested: https://docusign.example.com/ACME-2026-45
- Once we receive the signed form (signed to legal@redwood.example.com), ops@redwood.example.com will apply the account-level opt-out. Confirmation ticket + implementation note will be returned within 24–48 business hours.

3) Data residency, retention & deletion options:
- Data residency: Acme's hosted account will remain in US-only regions unless you request a different configuration.
- Retention: default operational logs retention is 90 days; we can offer shortened windows or run a one-time deletion on request (will require coordination and may affect troubleshooting history).

4) Evidence & SOC2/DPA:
- We can share SOC 2 / DPA artifacts under an NDA. I’ve linked our data-handling docs here: https://redwood.example.com/docs/data-handling. If you need SOC 2 artifacts, reply and we’ll share via the secure portal.
